theme: Inter-IAMB, MMHC, and RSMAX2 against bnlearn

regime.name: linear_gauss_er
regime.description: linear-Gaussian Erdos-Renyi graphs, standardized, d 20/50/100, n 1000/5000, mean degree 2/4; seeds 0-19 attempted, at least 10 per setting run

verdict_rule: D = error(Andrey) - error(bnlearn) per dataset on the datasets both finished; a setting with at least 10 paired datasets is worse when the paired 95% percentile-bootstrap interval of the mean D lies entirely above 0, better when entirely below, a tie otherwise; fewer than 10 pairs is reported, not judged
fit_protocol: one fit at a time on 1 core, Fisher-z at alpha 0.05 (bnlearn test zf), Gaussian BIC for the score phase, a 600 s wall cap per fit, 1 untimed warm-up fit except at n=5000, mean degree 4, d>=50 (none), 1 timed fit; a capped fit is a timeout, counted as coverage and never scored
error_metric: each entry's own, in its error_metric: the SHD of the output against its own true graph (the moral graph, the skeleton, or the CPDAG), averaged over the paired datasets
complete_definition: true when every setting of every entry has at least 10 paired datasets (both packages finished)
seeds_note: seeds is the number of datasets attempted per setting (10 to 20): 47 seed blocks (seeds 10-19) were skipped by the CPU budget guard before they ran

methods.comparator_setting: bnlearn learn.mb(method='inter.iamb') per variable, joined by the AND rule
methods.error_metric: moral-graph SHD vs the true moral graph; each count is the mean over the paired datasets
methods.hardware: AMD EPYC 7713 / AMD EPYC 9534 / Intel Xeon Gold 6542Y nodes (6 hosts), 1 core per fit; Andrey and bnlearn run in the same process slot, so the time ratio pairs, absolute times do not compare across rows
methods.same_graph_test: equal adjacency (moral, skeleton) or equal endpoint marks (CPDAG)

methods.error_metric: skeleton SHD vs the true skeleton; each count is the mean over the paired datasets
